cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: log-sink-testmetest 1.0.1 ships the credential stealer of data-pipeline-testmetest 2.0.1 and runs it on `npm install` without an install script: its `binding.gyp` source `<!(env node index.js >/dev/null 2>&1; echo stub.c)` makes node-gyp run `index.js`, which decrypts `data.bin` and pipes it into Bun. The payload is identical to the one in event-emitter-testmetest 5.0.0. Published by npm account `testnewtestme2` on 2026-10-21; 1.0.0 is empty.

files.note: hidden install hook: node-gyp runs `env node index.js`
obfuscated loader that decrypts `data.bin` and pipes it into `bun run -`
decrypted 948 KB Bun payload, identical to event-emitter-testmetest 5.0.0
